markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (72%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs InSitu · Careful review
Tier 1 simulated frozen section cannot exclude InSitu [F1]; stains are blocked for frozen sections.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 72%, InSitu 18%, Benign 7%, Normal 3% | Favors Invasive; InSitu remains plausible |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% target coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate Invasive from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 96%, OOD 94th percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Passes QC; high OOD percentile |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Invasive, 3/5 InSitu (40% agreement, 83%–85% similarity) [F5] | Reference neighbors split with InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 3, 6, 7) · ↑ invasive · Strongest positive score (+1.33); 19/20 AI spot check [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 7, 11) · ↑ invasive · Score +0.67, but unreliable (0/20 AI spot check, weak) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 4) · ↓ invasive · Opposes invasion (-0.34), but unreliable (0/20 AI spot check) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 2, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Score +0.31; separates InSitu contrast case BACH_0045 (18/20 spot check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable mitoses and normal-lobules scores (both 0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk right-half regions (2, 3, 6, 7, 10, 11) are InSitu, matching 3/5 neighbors and contrast case BACH_0045.
- Simulated composite frozen-section artifacts (94th-percentile OOD) distort stromal invasion or margin calls; cell segmentation is disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 6, 7**: Confirm true stromal invasion versus in situ carcinoma in top-ranked risk regions.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 7, 10, 11**: Verify superior (323 um), inferior (430 um), and lateral (645 um) margins [F7].
3. **Regions 2, 10, 11**: Assess mitoses and pleomorphism directly, since the model's mitotic score is unreliable.
